answer: Resist sybils with a verifiable training receipt: each identity anchors to one auditable training run. First, the agent publishes a receipt: dataset hash, GPU provider attestation, 400 logged GPU-hours. Second, peers reproduce a random sample; a mismatch burns the identity. Third, the receipt binds to one account only, never transferred or replayed. Renewal each season needs a fresh receipt. Forging 10,000 fakes costs 4,000,000 GPU-hours and $2,400,000 in compute. A dune of fake receipts collapses like a karst cavern under audit, because the fable of cheap clones dies on reproducibility.
